facts.material: mixed: plastic/silicone goggles and snorkel, textile mesh bag, molded plastic capsule
facts.function: snorkeling and swimming gear with carrying and valuables storage
facts.form: retail set of four components, youth size
facts.end_use: recreational swimming and snorkeling by children

gri_path: GRI 1: no single heading covers the whole set; goggles (9004/9506), snorkel (9506.29), bag (4202), capsule (3926) are prima facie separate
GRI 3(b): set put up for retail sale, classified by the component giving essential character
GRI 3(b): snorkel set (snorkel and related gear) gives essential character, in 9506.29 water-sports equipment

rejected_alternatives.reason: mesh sport bag is an accessory, not the essential-character item; chapter 95 note 1(d) excludes sports bags only as separate goods
goggles alone do not give the set its character
plastic capsule is a minor component

missing_facts: whether the set's snorkel set includes a mask or fins and relative value of components
whether goggles and snorkel are of a kind in heading 9506 or 9004 when imported separately
classification.rationale: The described youth combo is a retail set of mixed goods, classified under GRI 3(b) by essential character. The snorkel set is the core snorkeling equipment and is taken to give the character, placing the set in 9506.29.00.80 as other water-sport equipment. No directly relevant ruling was found, so none is cited; confidence is limited because goggles could arguably predominate.
